The great thing: AEDTP WORLD does it free. So if anyone says to pay before acquiring distribution through AEDTP WORLD, know it’s a lie. But if it’s true, then email: aedtpworld@aedtpworld.com for confirmation.

- Getting Paid: Available for distribution songs. You must provide your Spotify and Apple Music artist link before submitting your albums or songs
- Checkbox: You must check the GETTING PAID checkbox before uploading
- Artwork: Upload at least 3000px square artwork size for the song or album
- Files: Upload only mp3 files if possible. We don’t want to download large files
- Information: Don’t provide artist name instead of full name. Make sure you provide the exact information asked. If you filled in wrong, you won’t be taken serious again

- Originality: Use your own beat, don’t use anyone else’s. We will check your music before distributing to avoid distributing someone’s work
- Work Ethic: If you think your music is not generating more income, work harder. Don’t think we’re the artist who will work harder for you as the boss. Work harder. Because on AEDTP WORLD, we don’t promote laziness
- Character: Be patient, honest and hardworking
- Strict: We are now strict because of past experiences with artists and upcoming ones

AI Instrumentals
Go to http://aedtpworld.com/ai/ then go to PRODUCERS section and select any AI there and generate your instrumentals. Then use the instrumental.
https://aedtpworld.com/ai/

What We Won’t Accept
We won’t accept AI voices, infringements, sex sounds. Why? Because we don’t want AEDTP WORLD to be spreading bad words.
Even when we distribute moderate explicit songs, know we’re pitying you.
We are universal, therefore we recommend more clean songs.

Communication

title: Getting Promoted Worldwide
description: Get promoted worldwide. 100+ downloads on Blue Melody unlocks a Google Knowledge Panel, adds your songs to major music databases, and syndicates your lyrics globally with backlinks to your profiles. Check your global promotion.
content:
BLUE MELODY + LYRICSWORLD WORLDWIDE PROMOTION

The Song Must Match
The song on Blue Melody must be the same song as on LyricsWorld.

How To Get Promoted Worldwide

1. Downloads Unlock Everything
If your song on Blue Melody gets at least 100 downloads, it will be promoted.
Note: Downloads only. Not plays. Downloads cost data so they prove real fans.

When you hit 100+ downloads we will:
1. Create or improve your Google Knowledge Panel
2. Add your song and artist data to major music databases with links back to you
3. If the same song has Verified lyrics on LyricsWorld, we also syndicate those lyrics globally with backlinks to your profiles
4. Add links to your music on major platforms

If there are no lyrics, only the song gets promoted.

Important Requirements

Image Must Match
Before uploading to Blue Melody, upload your song image first.
Copy that same image URL and use it as the lyrics image URL on LyricsWorld.
When music and lyrics are live, the image must show correctly on both.
If the image does not show, it will NOT be promoted even with 100+ downloads.
Double check your image URL.

Sharing Tips
Lyrics: Share your lyrics to get discovered and gain views.
Music: Share your Blue Melody song to get more plays and downloads.
Remember: Only downloads count toward promotion.

What You Can Share
Lyrics
Artist page
Albums  
Music library page
Song page or songs

Sharing helps others find, play, and stream your music.

Note
We can change the download requirement rate anytime.
Visit the Help page from time to time for updates.
